Priya (CSM): Heads-up — Cobalt Systems renewal flagged. Usage down ~62% since champion left. New Eng Manager Alyssa mentions a NovaAI pilot. :warning:
Alyssa (Eng Manager): We're seeing slower p99s on long rerank jobs and higher costs vs their expectation. Can you share a compact comparison for our workload?
Jordan (Sales): Renewal in ~5w. Suggest immediate short bench to prove perf differences. I can propose a 2wk dedicated bench + credits.
Alex (Solutions Eng): I can produce p50/p95/p99 and a cost delta. Need 5 sample prompts and avg seq distribution. Priya, can you DM?
eng-bot: bench deploy 1812348000 started for cobalt; ETA 90m
Priya (CSM): DM sent with prompt samples and a few failure examples.
Jordan (Sales): Action list: 1) Perf slides (Alex) 2) One-pager cost/offer (Jordan) 3) Integration/security checklist (Priya). Goal: EOD Sun, call Mon 10am PT.
Alyssa (Eng Manager): Appreciate the quick turnaround. If bench shows parity on p99, procurement may re-open.
Priya (CSM): Noted. Will compile onboarding notes and two anonymized customer snippets showing cost wins.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Will share slides Sunday afternoon.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — will update thread after Monday call.
